arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَاوَاتِ السَّبْعِ، وَرَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، كُنْ لِي جَاراً مِنْ فُلَانِ بْنِ فُلَانٍ، وَأَحْزَابِهِ مِنْ خَلَائِقِكَ؛ أَنْ يَفْرُطَ عَلَيَّ أَحَدٌ مِنْهُمْ أَوْ يَطْغَى، عَزَّ جَارُكَ، وَجَلَّ ثَنَاؤُكَ، وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ.
transliteration: Allahumma rabbas-samaawaatis-sab'i, wa rabbal-'arshil-'atheem, kun lee jaaran min fulaan bin fulaan, wa ahzaabihi min khalaa'iqika; an yafruta 'alayya ahadun minhum aw yatghaa, 'azza jaaruka, wa jalla thanaa'uka, wa laa ilaaha illaa ant.
translation: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens, Lord of the Magnificent Throne, be my supporter against [such and such a person] and his helpers from among your creatures, lest any of them abuse me or do me wrong. Mighty is Your patronage and glorious are Your praises. There is none worthy of worship but You.

arabic: اللهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللهُ أَعَزُّ مِنْ خَلْقِهِ جَمِيعاً، اللهُ أَعَزُّ مِمَّا أَخَافُ وَأَحْذَرُ، أَعُوذُ بِاللهِ الَّذِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ، الْمُمْسِكِ السَّمَاوَاتِ السَّبْعِ أَنْ يَقَعْنَ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ، مِنْ شَرِّ عَبْدِكَ فُلَانٍ، وَجُنُودِهِ وَأَتْبَاعِهِ وَأَشْيَاعِهِ، مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنْسِ، اللَّهُمَّ كُنْ لِي جَاراً مِنْ شَرِّهِمْ، جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُكَ وَعَزَّ جَارُكَ، وَتَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ، وَلَا إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ.
transliteration: Allaahu akbar, Allaahu a'azzu min khalqihi jamee'an, Allaahu a'azzu mimmaa akhaafu wa ahtharu, a'oothu billaahil-lathee laa ilaaha illaa huwa, al-mumsikis-samaawaatis-sab'i an yaqa'na 'alal-ardhi illaa bi'ithnihi, min sharri 'abdika fulaan, wa junoodihi wa atbaa'ihi wa ashyaa'ihi, minal-jinni walinsi, Allahumma kun lee jaaran min sharrihim, jalla thanaa'uka wa 'azza jaaruka, wa tabaarakasmuka, wa laa ilaaha ghayruk.
translation: Allah is the Most Great, Allah is mightier than all His creation, Allah is mightier than what I fear and dread. I seek refuge in Allah, who there is none worthy of worship but Him, the One who holds the seven heavens from falling upon the earth except by His command, from the evil of Your slave [such and such a person], and his helpers, his followers and his supporters from among the jinn and mankind. O Allah, be my supporter against their evil. Glorious are Your praises and mighty is Your patronage. Blessed is Your name, there is no true God but You. (Recite three times)
